en.titre:
10/10 social hobbies that
actually work if you have adhd

colonne: knowing you'll talk about it on thursday makes it easier to actually _finish_ the book
en.chute: pick a short book and invite three friends

colonne: a weekly run with friends gives your week structure, and a shared goal keeps everyone _going_
_pro tip_: i use atala, an ai running coach that plans my week around my goal
en.chute: same day, same place, every week

en.accroche: the ball is _everywhere_, so _you are too_
colonne: fast passes and a team around you keep your attention on the game for the whole hour
en.chute: most parks have a casual game on sundays

colonne: comparing what you each noticed turns a quiet visit into a conversation
_pro tip_: i use artura, one artwork a day with its story, zooming into the details you'd miss
en.chute: each pick one piece to show the other

colonne: it's social, hands-on and done in one evening, and you leave with new recipes and new friends
en.chute: start with four people and one theme
